D121　租户与工单的数据范围

第 18 周 · 2 小时。前置阅读为 D120-当前用户与场景权限。本章使用 Node.js 20、pnpm 10、NestJS 12 与 PostgreSQL。

今天要做出什么

为验证工程原有账号、班组和运行补上租户。以能跨班组查看报表的经理为例，证明可见范围还受到租户的约束，并在工单转租后检查旧运行。

零、闭卷回忆

D120　自动诊断允许读取私人笔记吗？

核对答案

服务端依据场景判断，自动诊断只读工单证据。

D118　上周固定评测对比了哪些量？

核对答案

逐题分类、停止原因、步数、延迟及 token。

D114　读工具怎样判断还有下一页？

核对答案

多读一条记录，以是否超过 limit 决定游标。

再复测错题本中今天到期的条目。

一、知识点与可运行示例

1.1 给跨班组权限加上租户边界

经理可能没有直属班组。先从账号记录取得租户，再用工单或设备关联班组的租户筛选资源。即使 W3 的 groupScope 对经理返回空条件，租户条件仍然存在。迁移把原有记录统一归入 legacy。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run src/agent/agent-scope.spec.ts -t "跨班组查看仍然带租户条件"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/src/agent/agent-scope.spec.ts，第四节含完整导入与夹具。

  it('跨班组查看仍然带租户条件', () => {
    expect(agentScope({ ...user, permissions: ['ticket:all-groups'] })).toEqual({ group: { tenantKey: 'east' } });
    expect(() => agentScope({ ...user, tenantKey: undefined })).toThrow('TOOL_FORBIDDEN');
  });

推导题　为什么不能直接用 groupId 充当 tenantKey？

答案

一个租户可以有多个班组，经理还可能没有 groupId。单独记录租户才能表达跨班组又不能跨客户的权限。

1.2 让历史运行跟随当前可见范围

运行记录保留发起人和创建时租户。详情读取先确定所有者，再查询当前工单归属。列表按页从候选运行中筛选可见项，事件流在每次取下一批事件前也再次核对。

在 apps/server 运行 pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.e2e.ts test/agent-tenant.e2e-spec.ts -t "经理可读同租户其他班组并在工单转租后失去运行可见性"。下面的用例取自 apps/server/test/agent-tenant.e2e-spec.ts，第四节含完整导入与夹具。

  it('经理可读同租户其他班组并在工单转租后失去运行可见性', async () => {
    const west = await db.group.create({ data: { code: 'test-tenant-west', name: '外部租户班组', tenantKey: 'west' } });
    const ticket = await fixtures.create({ group: 'ops-b' });
    const auth = (await tokenIssuer(app))('dave');
    const api = request(app.getHttpServer());
    const start = () => api.post('/api/agent/runs').set('authorization', auth)
      .send({ requestKey: randomUUID(), ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo, goal: '核对班组' });
    const run = (await start().expect(201)).body.data;
    await db.ticket.update({ where: { id: ticket.id }, data: { groupId: west.id } });
    await start().expect(404);
    await api.get('/api/agent/runs/' + run.id).set('authorization', auth).expect(404);
    const list = await api.get('/api/agent/runs').set('authorization', auth).expect(200);
    expect(list.body.data.some((item: { id: string }) => item.id === run.id)).toBe(false);
  });

推导题　调走工单后，旧运行为什么也要隐藏？

答案

运行目标、处理轨迹和诊断结论都可能透露工单内容。只检查运行发起人会继续展示已经调出的资源。

二、自己动手

步骤 1　迁移既有数据

提示一 · 方向

把账号、班组、运行三张表放在一起核对。

提示二 · API

部署 Prisma 迁移并重新生成客户端。

提示三 · 实现顺序

为三张表补 tenant_key；用一张历史工单和一个同租户账号验证升级后的访问。

步骤 2　在运行入口复核可见性

提示一 · 方向

检查创建、列表、详情和事件流的读取位置。

提示二 · API

用 agentScope 构建工单和设备的 where。

提示三 · 实现顺序

从服务端新读账号，组合租户和班组条件；工单调出后复查旧运行。

三、自检与提交

运行租户接口用例，分别记录建单、工单转租、旧详情、旧列表四步结果。说明访问拒绝时为什么不向调用方透露另一个租户的名称。

在验证工程的 apps/server 下运行 pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy 和 pnpm exec prisma generate。回到工作区根目录运行 pnpm run ci，对照文末三轮接口测试结果。

反证 A　在 apps/server/src/agent/agent-scope.ts 把 throw new CallError('TOOL_FORBIDDEN') 临时替为 throw new CallError('SCOPE_MISSING')，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected [Function] to throw error including 'TOOL_FORBIDDEN' but got 'SCOPE_MISSING'

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

反证 B　在 apps/server/src/agent/agent-scope.ts 把 ...groupScope(user), group: 临时替为 ...groupScope(user), id: { in: [] }, group:，运行同一用例。原始失败输出如下。

AssertionError: expected { Object (groupId, id, ...) } to deeply equal { groupId: '班组甲', …(1) }

恢复后文件 SHA-256 与实验前相同，同一用例复测通过。

提交批改　提交实际 diff、一次正常输出、一条失败断言和恢复结果。说明哪一步看过提示，并说“D121 提交了”。

apps/server/src/agent/agent-scope.spec.ts

import { agentScope } from './agent-scope.js';

describe('租户与班组交集', () => {
  const user = { id: 'u', username: '测试人员', tenantKey: 'east', groupId: '班组甲' };
  it('跨班组查看仍然带租户条件', () => {
    expect(agentScope({ ...user, permissions: ['ticket:all-groups'] })).toEqual({ group: { tenantKey: 'east' } });
    expect(() => agentScope({ ...user, tenantKey: undefined })).toThrow('TOOL_FORBIDDEN');
  });
  it('班组成员的查询同时携带两项条件', () => {
    expect(agentScope(user)).toEqual({ groupId: '班组甲', group: { tenantKey: 'east' } });
    expect(agentScope({ ...user, groupId: null })).toHaveProperty('id.in', []);
  });
});

apps/server/src/agent/agent-scope.ts

import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { groupScope } from '../auth/group-scope.js';
import { CallError } from './tool-catalog.js';

// 账号的租户从库中读取；班组的租户由资源的关联记录决定。
export function agentScope(user: AuthUser) {
  if (!user.tenantKey) throw new CallError('TOOL_FORBIDDEN');
  return { ...groupScope(user), group: { tenantKey: user.tenantKey } };
}

apps/server/prisma/schema.prisma

// 工单系统数据模型，对应 docs/data-model.md
// 状态、优先级等取值限制和跨字段规则 Prisma schema 表达不了，写在迁移 SQL 的 CHECK 约束里

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output   = "../src/generated/prisma"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

model User {
  tenantKey String @default("legacy") @map("tenant_key") @db.VarChar(64)
  id           String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  username     String   @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  displayName  String   @map("display_name") @db.VarChar(64)
  // 密码的 scrypt 哈希，格式见 src/auth/password.ts；为空表示这个账号不能登录（D15）
  passwordHash String?  @map("password_hash") @db.VarChar(255)
  // 所属班组（D17）；系统账号、跨班组的管理人员可以没有班组
  groupId      String?  @map("group_id") @db.Uuid
  // 手机号（D19）：敏感字段，没有 contact:read 权限的人看到的是脱敏后的 138****0001
  phone        String?  @db.VarChar(20)
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  group     Group?     @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  roles     UserRole[]
  auditLogs AuditLog[]

  toolNotes AgentToolNote[]
  reportedTickets Ticket[]      @relation("TicketReporter")
  assignedTickets Ticket[]      @relation("TicketAssignee")
  ticketEvents    TicketEvent[]
  notifications   Notification[]
  aiQuotas        AiQuota[]
  aiConversations AiConversation[]

  @@map("users")
  agentRuns AgentRun[]
}

model Device {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  code      String   @unique @db.VarChar(32)
  name      String   @db.VarChar(128)
  type      String   @db.VarChar(32)
  location  String?  @db.VarChar(128)
  // 设备归哪个班组维护；告警自动建的工单归这个班组（D17）
  groupId   String   @map("group_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  group   Group    @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  tickets Ticket[]
  alerts  Alert[]

  @@map("devices")
}

model Ticket {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  ticketNo    String    @unique @map("ticket_no") @db.VarChar(20)
  title       String    @db.VarChar(200)
  description String    @default("")
  category    String    @default("other") @db.VarChar(16)
  creationKey String?   @map("creation_key") @db.Uuid
  creationHash String?  @map("creation_hash") @db.VarChar(64)
  status      String    @default("pending") @db.VarChar(16)
  priority    String    @default("P3") @db.VarChar(2)
  deviceId    String?   @map("device_id") @db.Uuid
  reporterId  String    @map("reporter_id") @db.Uuid
  assigneeId  String?   @map("assignee_id") @db.Uuid
  // 工单归属的班组：只有这个班组的人能看、能处理（D17 行级权限）
  groupId     String    @map("group_id") @db.Uuid
  version     Int       @default(0)
  slaDueAt    DateTime  @map("sla_due_at") @db.Timestamptz
  resolvedAt  DateTime? @map("resolved_at") @db.Timestamptz
  closedAt    DateTime? @map("closed_at") @db.Timestamptz
  // SLA 超时扫描（D25）发出超时通知的时间；为空表示还没通知过。条件更新它，保证每张工单只通知一次
  slaBreachedAt DateTime? @map("sla_breached_at") @db.Timestamptz
  // 超时满 30 分钟仍待处理时升级一次；和升级事件在同一事务里写入（D32）
  slaEscalatedAt DateTime? @map("sla_escalated_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz
  // @updatedAt 由 Prisma Client 在每次更新时填写，绕过 Prisma 的写入不会刷新它
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamptz

  device   Device? @relation(fields: [deviceId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  reporter User    @relation("TicketReporter", fields: [reporterId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  assignee User?   @relation("TicketAssignee", fields: [assigneeId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  group    Group   @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  toolNotes AgentToolNote[]
  alerts Alert[]
  events TicketEvent[]

  // 工作台列表：按状态筛选、按创建时间倒序；末尾加 id，和排序完全一致，游标分页也能直接用（D5）
  @@index([status, createdAt(sort: Desc), id(sort: Desc)], map: "tickets_status_created_at_id_idx")
  // 班组的工作台列表：班组是等值条件，放在最前面（D4：等值条件在前、排序列在后）（D17）
  @@index([groupId, status, createdAt(sort: Desc), id(sort: Desc)], map: "tickets_group_status_created_at_id_idx")
  // 我的工单：按处理人和状态筛选
  @@index([assigneeId, status], map: "tickets_assignee_status_idx")
  @@unique([reporterId, creationKey], map: "tickets_reporter_creation_unique")
  @@map("tickets")
}

model Alert {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  deviceId   String   @map("device_id") @db.Uuid
  ticketId   String?  @map("ticket_id") @db.Uuid
  source     String   @db.VarChar(32)
  dedupKey   String   @map("dedup_key") @db.VarChar(128)
  severity   String   @db.VarChar(16)
  message    String
  occurredAt DateTime @map("occurred_at") @db.Timestamptz
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  device Device  @relation(fields: [deviceId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  ticket Ticket? @relation(fields: [ticketId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  // 同一来源的同一告警只保留一条
  @@unique([source, dedupKey], map: "alerts_source_dedup_key_unique")
  // 工单详情统计合并的告警数量
  @@index([ticketId], map: "alerts_ticket_id_idx")
  // 设备的告警列表：按发生时间倒序，游标分页（D7 变式练习）
  @@index([deviceId, occurredAt(sort: Desc), id(sort: Desc)], map: "alerts_device_occurred_at_id_idx")
  @@map("alerts")
}

model TicketEvent {
  id         String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  ticketId   String   @map("ticket_id") @db.Uuid
  actorId    String   @map("actor_id") @db.Uuid
  type       String   @db.VarChar(16)
  fromStatus String?  @map("from_status") @db.VarChar(16)
  toStatus   String?  @map("to_status") @db.VarChar(16)
  content    String   @default("")
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  ticket Ticket @relation(fields: [ticketId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  actor  User   @relation(fields: [actorId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

  // 工单详情按时间列出处理记录
  @@index([ticketId, createdAt], map: "ticket_events_ticket_id_created_at_idx")
  @@map("ticket_events")
}

// ---------- 角色与权限（D16） ----------
// 权限点的取值见 packages/shared/src/permissions.ts；角色和“角色有哪些权限”是数据，由种子写入

model Role {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  code      String   @unique @db.VarChar(32)
  name      String   @db.VarChar(64)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  permissions RolePermission[]
  users       UserRole[]

  @@map("roles")
}

model Permission {
  id          String @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  code        String @unique @db.VarChar(64)
  description String @db.VarChar(200)

  roles RolePermission[]

  @@map("permissions")
}

// 关联表：删除角色或权限时，关联行跟着删（Cascade）。
// 这是对“外键一律 RESTRICT”（D1）的有意例外：关联行不是业务历史，留着没有意义
model RolePermission {
  roleId       String @map("role_id") @db.Uuid
  permissionId String @map("permission_id") @db.Uuid

  role       Role       @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  permission Permission @relation(fields: [permissionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([roleId, permissionId])
  // 主键以 role_id 开头，按权限查角色要单独的索引
  @@index([permissionId], map: "role_permissions_permission_id_idx")
  @@map("role_permissions")
}

model UserRole {
  userId    String   @map("user_id") @db.Uuid
  roleId    String   @map("role_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role Role @relation(fields: [roleId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([userId, roleId])
  @@index([roleId], map: "user_roles_role_id_idx")
  @@map("user_roles")
}

// ---------- 班组（D17） ----------
model Group {
  tenantKey String @default("legacy") @map("tenant_key") @db.VarChar(64)
  id        String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  code      String   @unique @db.VarChar(32)
  name      String   @db.VarChar(64)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz

  users   User[]
  devices Device[]
  tickets Ticket[]

  manuals RetrievalManual[]
  @@map("groups")
}

// 运维手册的权威原文。停用后读侧即时拒绝引用。
model RetrievalManual {
  id      String @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  groupId String @map("group_id") @db.Uuid
  title   String @db.VarChar(200)
  body    String
  active  Boolean @default(true)
  group   Group @relation(fields: [groupId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  @@map("retrieval_manuals")
}

// ---------- 操作审计（D18） ----------
// 只追加、不修改、不删除：迁移里用触发器在数据库层拒绝 UPDATE、DELETE、TRUNCATE
model AuditLog {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  occurredAt    DateTime @default(now()) @map("occurred_at") @db.Timestamptz
  actorId       String   @map("actor_id") @db.Uuid
  // 操作时的用户名快照：以后用户改名，审计里仍是当时的名字
  actorUsername String   @map("actor_username") @db.VarChar(64)
  // 做了什么，例如 ticket.transition、ticket.batch_assign
  action        String   @db.VarChar(64)
  entityType    String   @map("entity_type") @db.VarChar(32)
  // 业务上的标识（工单编号、设备编码），不用外键：被审计的数据删了，审计也要留着
  entityKey     String   @map("entity_key") @db.VarChar(64)
  before        Json?
  after         Json?
  // 同一个请求产生的审计、日志用它串起来
  requestId     String?  @map("request_id") @db.VarChar(64)

  actor User @relation(fields: [actorId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)

}

// Outbox（D31）：业务事务里顺手写一行“要发出去的事件”，和业务数据一起提交或一起回滚
// 投递器（OutboxRelay）再把还没投递的行放进队列，放进去以后填上 published_at
model OutboxEvent {
  id          String    @id @default(uuid(7)) @db.Uuid
  // ticket.assigned、ticket.sla_breached、ticket.sla_escalated
  type        String    @db.VarChar(64)

  publishedAt DateTime? @map("published_at") @db.Timestamptz

  // 投递器每次按创建时间取还没投递的
  @@index([publishedAt, createdAt], map: "outbox_events_unpublished_idx")
  @@map("outbox_events")
}

model Notification {

  // D33：SSE 的持久游标。写入入口先锁用户，再分配序号并提交，避免同一用户提交乱序。
  streamSeq BigInt    @unique @default(autoincrement()) @map("stream_seq")
  userId    String    @map("user_id") @db.Uuid

  // 查“我的通知”，按时间倒序

  @@index([userId, streamSeq], map: "notifications_user_stream_idx")

}

import { Body, Header, Controller, Get, HttpCode, HttpException, Param, Post, Query, Req, Sse, UseGuards,
  type MessageEvent } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Observable } from 'rxjs';
import { eventPageSchema, eventViewSchema, runDetailSchema, runListSchema, runStartSchema, runVersionSchema,
  runViewSchema, stepViewSchema, tracePageSchema, traceViewSchema } from '@ops-ticket/shared';
import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { CurrentUser } from '../common/current-user.decorator.js';
import { RequirePermission } from '../auth/permissions.decorator.js';
import { AgentRunsService } from './agent-runs.service.js';
import { AgentJournalService } from './agent-journal.service.js';
import { RunTraceService } from './run-trace.service.js';
import { RunStreamService } from './run-stream.service.js';
import { RunStreamGuard, RunTicketService, type RunStreamRequest } from './run-stream.ticket.js';
import { RawResponse } from '../common/response.interceptor.js';
import { Public } from '../auth/public.decorator.js';
import { DiagnosisService } from './diagnosis.service.js';
import { RunFailure } from './run-errors.js';
import { RunStateError } from './run-state.js';
import { z } from 'zod';

type RunRow = Awaited<ReturnType<AgentRunsService['get']>>;
type StepRow = Awaited<ReturnType<AgentJournalService['steps']>>[number];
type EventRow = Awaited<ReturnType<AgentJournalService['events']>>[number];

export function stepView(step: StepRow) {
  return stepViewSchema.parse({
    id: step.id, ordinal: step.ordinal, phase: step.phase, status: step.status, summary: step.summary,
    errorCode: step.errorCode, startedAt: step.startedAt.toISOString(),
    endedAt: step.endedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
  });
}

// 事件对外只给序号、类型、所属步序和扁平载荷；不暴露内部主键。
export function eventView(event: EventRow, stepOrdinal: number | null) {
  return eventViewSchema.parse({
    seq: event.seq, type: event.type, stepOrdinal,
    payload: event.payload ?? {}, createdAt: event.createdAt.toISOString(),
  });
}

export function runView(run: RunRow) {
  return runViewSchema.parse({
    id: run.id, ticketNo: run.ticketNo, goal: run.goal, status: run.status, stopReason: run.stopReason,
    version: run.version, stepCount: run.stepCount, createdAt: run.createdAt.toISOString(),
    startedAt: run.startedAt?.toISOString() ?? null, endedAt: run.endedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
  });
}

// 输入问题是 400，看不到是 404，权限变化是 403；状态类问题（转移不允许或被别人改过）都是 409。
export function runHttpStatus(code: string, stateError = false) {
  if (stateError) return 409;
  if (code.endsWith('NOT_FOUND')) return 404;
  if (code === 'RUN_INPUT_INVALID') return 400;
  if (code === 'RUN_SCOPE_CHANGED') return 403;
  return 409;
}

function httpError(error: unknown): never {
  if (error instanceof HttpException) throw error;
  const known = error instanceof RunFailure || error instanceof RunStateError;
  const code = known ? error.code : 'RUN_FAILED';
  throw new HttpException({ code, message: '运行请求未完成，请查看运行状态后再试' },
    known ? runHttpStatus(code, error instanceof RunStateError) : 503);
}

@Controller('agent/runs')
@RequirePermission('ticket:read')
export class AgentRunsController {
  constructor(private readonly diagnosis: DiagnosisService, private readonly runs: AgentRunsService, private readonly journal: AgentJournalService,
    private readonly traces: RunTraceService, private readonly streams: RunStreamService,
    private readonly tickets: RunTicketService) {}

  @Post() @HttpCode(201)
  async start(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Body() input: unknown) {
    try {
      const parsed = runStartSchema.safeParse(input);
      if (!parsed.success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
      const { run } = await this.runs.start(user, parsed.data);
      return runView(run);
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  @Get()
  async list(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser) {
    try { return runListSchema.parse((await this.runs.list(user)).map(runView)); } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  @Get(':id')
  async detail(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string) {
    try {
      const run = await this.runs.get(user, id);
      return runDetailSchema.parse({ run: runView(run), steps: (await this.journal.steps(run.id)).map(stepView) });
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  // 增量拉取：客户端带上已经看到的最大序号，只取后面的事件。
  @Get(':id/events')
  async events(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Query('after') after?: string) {
    try {
      const run = await this.runs.get(user, id);
      const parsed = z.coerce.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000).safeParse(after ?? 0);
      if (!parsed.success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
      const steps = await this.journal.steps(run.id);
      const ordinals = new Map(steps.map(step => [step.id, step.ordinal]));
      const events = await this.journal.events(run.id, parsed.data);
      const views = events.map(event => eventView(event, event.stepId ? ordinals.get(event.stepId) ?? null : null));
      return eventPageSchema.parse({ runId: run.id, events: views, lastSeq: views.at(-1)?.seq ?? parsed.data });
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  // Trace 只给运行的发起人；内容已在写入时脱敏并截断。
  @Get(':id/traces')
  async traceList(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string) {
    try {
      const run = await this.runs.get(user, id);
      const rows = await this.traces.list(run.id);
      return tracePageSchema.parse({
        runId: run.id,
        traces: rows.map(row => traceViewSchema.parse({
          ordinal: row.ordinal, kind: row.kind, input: row.input, output: row.output,
          inputTokens: row.inputTokens, outputTokens: row.outputTokens,
          durationMs: row.durationMs, truncated: row.truncated,
        })),
        usage: await this.traces.usage(run.id),
      });
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  // 先用已登录的接口换一张短期票据：EventSource 不能带 Authorization 头。
  @Post(':id/stream-ticket') @HttpCode(201)
  async streamTicket(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    try {
      const run = await this.runs.get(user, id);
      const parsed = z.object({ after: z.number().int().min(0).max(1_000_000).default(0) })
        .strict().safeParse(input ?? {});
      if (!parsed.success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
      return await this.tickets.issue(user.id, run.id, parsed.data.after);
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  @Post(':id/diagnose') @HttpCode(200)
  async diagnose(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string) {
    try { return runView((await this.diagnosis.execute(user, id)).run); } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  @Post(':id/cancel') @HttpCode(200)
  async cancel(@CurrentUser() user: AuthUser, @Param('id') id: string, @Body() input: unknown) {
    try {
      const parsed = runVersionSchema.safeParse(input);
      if (!parsed.success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
      return runView(await this.runs.cancel(user, id, parsed.data.version));
    } catch (error) { httpError(error); }
  }

  // 票据在守卫里兑换；本路由不走常规登录态，所以标 Public 并单独鉴权。
  @Public()
  @UseGuards(RunStreamGuard)
  @RawResponse()
  @Header('X-Accel-Buffering', 'no')
  @Sse(':id/stream', { maxPendingDataLength: 64 * 1024 })
  stream(@Req() request: RunStreamRequest): Observable<MessageEvent> {
    const { userId, runId, after } = request.runStream;
    return this.streams.open(userId, runId, after);
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { PrismaService, type TransactionClient } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { agentScope } from './agent-scope.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { ReadToolsService } from '../assistant/read-tools.service.js';
import { assertTransition, statusForReason, type RunStatus, type StopReason } from './run-state.js';
import { RunFailure } from './run-errors.js';

const startSchema = z.object({
  requestKey: z.uuid(),
  ticketNo: z.string().trim().min(1).max(32),
  goal: z.string().trim().min(1).max(500),
}).strict();
export type StartInput = z.infer<typeof startSchema>;
export const RUN_LIMIT = 20;

@Injectable()
export class AgentRunsService {
  constructor(private readonly db: PrismaService, private readonly tools: ReadToolsService) {}

  // 开跑前先确认工单在当前用户的数据权限范围内；范围由 W3 的 groupScope 决定。
  private async target(user: AuthUser, ticketNo: string) {
    const ticket = await this.db.ticket.findFirst({
      where: { ...agentScope(user), ticketNo }, select: { ticketNo: true },
    });
    if (!ticket) throw new RunFailure('RUN_TICKET_NOT_FOUND');
    return ticket.ticketNo;
  }

  async start(user: AuthUser, input: unknown) {
    const parsed = startSchema.safeParse(input);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
    const { requestKey, goal } = parsed.data;
    const { user: liveUser, fingerprint } = await this.tools.access(user.id);
    const ticketNo = await this.target(liveUser, parsed.data.ticketNo);
    // 同一用户同一请求键只建一次：重试拿回原来的 Run，不会重复开跑。
    const existing = await this.db.agentRun.findUnique({ where: { userId_requestKey: { userId: user.id, requestKey } } });
    if (existing) {
      if (existing.tenantKey !== liveUser.tenantKey) throw new RunFailure('RUN_NOT_FOUND');
      if (existing.ticketNo !== ticketNo || existing.goal !== goal) throw new RunFailure('RUN_REQUEST_KEY_CONFLICT');
      return { run: existing, replay: true };
    }
    return this.db.serializable(async tx => {
      const live = await tx.agentRun.count({ where: { userId: user.id, status: { in: ['queued', 'running'] } } });
      if (live >= RUN_LIMIT) throw new RunFailure('RUN_LIMIT');
      const run = await tx.agentRun.create({
        data: { tenantKey: liveUser.tenantKey, userId: user.id, requestKey, ticketNo, goal, scopeHash: fingerprint },
      });
      return { run, replay: false };
    });
  }

  async get(user: Pick<AuthUser, 'id'>, id: string) {
    if (!z.uuid().safeParse(id).success) throw new RunFailure('RUN_INPUT_INVALID');
    const run = await this.db.agentRun.findFirst({ where: { id, userId: user.id } });
    if (!run) throw new RunFailure('RUN_NOT_FOUND');
    const { user: live } = await this.tools.access(user.id);
    if (run.tenantKey !== live.tenantKey) throw new RunFailure('RUN_NOT_FOUND');
    await this.target(live, run.ticketNo);
    return run;
  }

  async list(user: AuthUser) {
    const { user: live } = await this.tools.access(user.id);
    const visible: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof this.db.agentRun.findMany>> = [];
    let cursor: string | undefined;
    while (visible.length < 30) {
      const page = await this.db.agentRun.findMany({
        where: { userId: user.id, tenantKey: live.tenantKey }, orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }],
        take: 30, ...(cursor ? { cursor: { id: cursor }, skip: 1 } : {}),
      });
      const rows = await this.db.ticket.findMany({ where: { ...agentScope(live), ticketNo: { in: page.map(x => x.ticketNo) } },
        select: { ticketNo: true } });
      const names = new Set(rows.map(row => row.ticketNo));
      visible.push(...page.filter(row => names.has(row.ticketNo)));
      if (page.length < 30) break;
      cursor = page.at(-1)!.id;
    }
    return visible.slice(0, 30);
  }

  // 状态推进统一走条件更新：WHERE 带上旧状态和版本，影响 0 行就是被别人改过。
  private async move(id: string, from: RunStatus, to: RunStatus, version: number,
    reason?: StopReason, extra: { startedAt?: Date; endedAt?: Date } = {}, db: TransactionClient | PrismaService = this.db) {
    assertTransition(from, to, reason);
    const result = await db.agentRun.updateMany({
      where: { id, status: from, version },
      data: { status: to, version: { increment: 1 }, stopReason: reason ?? null, ...extra },
    });
    if (result.count !== 1) throw new RunFailure('RUN_STATE_CONFLICT');
    return db.agentRun.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
  }

  // 认领：把 queued 变成 running。多个工作者同时认领只有一个成功。
  async claim(user: AuthUser, id: string, version: number) {
    const run = await this.get(user, id);
    if (run.scopeHash !== (await this.tools.access(user.id)).fingerprint) throw new RunFailure('RUN_SCOPE_CHANGED');
    return this.move(run.id, run.status as RunStatus, 'running', version, undefined, { startedAt: new Date() });
  }

  // 收尾：停止原因决定终态，不让调用方自己挑状态。
  async finish(id: string, version: number, reason: StopReason, from: RunStatus = 'running', tx?: TransactionClient) {
    return this.move(id, from, statusForReason(reason), version, reason, { endedAt: new Date() }, tx);
  }

  async cancel(user: AuthUser, id: string, version: number) {
    const run = await this.get(user, id);
    return this.finish(run.id, version, 'user_cancelled', run.status as RunStatus);
  }
}

  constructor(private readonly journal: AgentJournalService, private readonly live: RunLiveHub,
    private readonly db: PrismaService, private readonly runs: AgentRunsService,
    @Inject(RUN_STREAM_OPTIONS) private readonly options: RunStreamOptions) {}

  // 关闭前主动通知客户端重连，不是悄悄断开（沿用 D33 的做法）。
  beginShutdown() {
    this.stopping = true;
    for (const close of this.closers) close();
  }

  open(userId: string, runId: string, after: number): Observable<MessageEvent> {
    return new Observable<MessageEvent>(observer => {
      if (this.stopping) { observer.complete(); return; }
      const connection = Symbol();
      this.connections.add(connection);
      let disposed = false;
      let running = false;
      let dirty = true;
      let cursor = after;
      const close = () => {
        observer.next({ id: runCursor(cursor), type: 'reauth', data: { reason: 'server-shutdown' } });
        observer.complete();
      };
      this.closers.add(close);

      const drain = async () => {
        dirty = true;
        if (running || disposed) return;
        running = true;
        try {
          while (dirty && !disposed) {
            dirty = false;
            // 按 seq 续传：客户端带着已收到的最大序号，不会重复也不会漏。
            await this.runs.get({ id: userId }, runId);
            const events = await this.journal.events(runId, cursor, 100);
            for (const event of events) {
              if (disposed) return;
              cursor = event.seq;
              observer.next({ id: runCursor(cursor), type: event.type,
                data: { seq: event.seq, type: event.type, payload: event.payload ?? {},
                  createdAt: event.createdAt.toISOString() } });
            }
            if (events.length === 100) dirty = true;
            // 运行已结束且事件全部发完，主动结束这条流，不让客户端一直挂着。
            if (!dirty) {
              const run = await this.db.agentRun.findUnique({ where: { id: runId }, select: { status: true, eventSeq: true } });
              if (!run) { observer.complete(); return; }
              const terminal = run.status !== 'queued' && run.status !== 'running';
              if (terminal && cursor >= run.eventSeq) {
                observer.next({ id: runCursor(cursor), type: 'closed', data: { status: run.status } });
                observer.complete();
                return;
              }
            }
          }
        } catch (error) {
          observer.error(error);
        } finally {
          running = false;
        }
      };

      const unsubscribe = this.live.subscribe(runId, () => { void drain(); });
      const poll = setInterval(() => { void drain(); }, this.options.pollMs);
      const heartbeat = setInterval(() => {
        // 心跳是命名事件，不推进业务游标。
        observer.next({ type: 'heartbeat', data: { at: new Date().toISOString() } });
      }, this.options.heartbeatMs);
      void drain();

      return () => {
        disposed = true;
        clearInterval(poll);
        clearInterval(heartbeat);
        unsubscribe();
        this.closers.delete(close);
        this.connections.delete(connection);
      };
    });
  }
}

import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { agentScope } from './agent-scope.js';
import { redactForLog } from '../common/sensitive.js';
import type { TransactionClient } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { CallError, pageArgs, type Name } from './tool-catalog.js';

export function shortText(value: string, limit = 240) {
  const chars = Array.from(redactForLog(value));
  return { text: chars.slice(0, limit).join(''), clipped: chars.length > limit };
}
export function pageOf<T extends { id: string }>(rows: T[], limit: number) {
  const items = rows.slice(0, limit);
  return { items, next: rows.length > limit ? items.at(-1)!.id : null };
}
export async function visibleTicket(tx: TransactionClient, user: AuthUser, ticketNo: string) {
  const ticket = await tx.ticket.findFirst({
    where: { ...agentScope(user), ticketNo }, select: { id: true, ticketNo: true, title: true, description: true,
      priority: true, status: true, deviceId: true, slaDueAt: true, slaEscalatedAt: true, resolvedAt: true,
      assignee: { select: { displayName: true } } },
  });
  if (!ticket) throw new CallError('TOOL_TARGET_NOT_FOUND');
  return ticket;
}
export async function readTicketTool(tx: TransactionClient, user: AuthUser, ticketNo: string, name: Name, args: unknown) {
  const row = await visibleTicket(tx, user, ticketNo);
  switch (name) {
    case 'ticket_summary': return { ticketNo, title: shortText(row.title, 160), description: shortText(row.description),
      status: row.status, priority: row.priority };
    case 'ticket_sla': return { dueAt: row.slaDueAt.toISOString(), escalatedAt: row.slaEscalatedAt?.toISOString() ?? null,
      resolvedAt: row.resolvedAt?.toISOString() ?? null };
    case 'ticket_owner': return { assignedTo: row.assignee ? shortText(row.assignee.displayName, 64).text : null };
    case 'ticket_device': {
      if (!row.deviceId) return { device: null };
      const device = await tx.device.findFirst({ where: { ...agentScope(user), id: row.deviceId },
        select: { code: true, name: true, type: true } });
      return { device: device ? { code: device.code, name: shortText(device.name).text, type: device.type } : null };
    }
    case 'ticket_alert_counts': {
      const groups = await tx.alert.groupBy({ by: ['severity'], where: { ticketId: row.id, device: agentScope(user) },
        _count: { _all: true }, orderBy: { severity: 'asc' }, take: 16 });
      return { counts: groups.map(g => ({ severity: g.severity, count: g._count._all })) };
    }
    case 'ticket_history_page':
    case 'ticket_alert_page': {
      const { limit, after } = pageArgs.parse(args);
      const where = { ticketId: row.id, ...(after ? { id: { gt: after } } : {}) };
      const paging = { orderBy: { id: 'asc' as const }, take: limit + 1 };
      if (name === 'ticket_alert_page') {
        const alerts = await tx.alert.findMany({ ...paging, where: { ...where, device: agentScope(user) },
          select: { id: true, severity: true, message: true } });
        return pageOf(alerts.map(a => ({ id: a.id, severity: a.severity, message: shortText(a.message) })), limit);
      }
      const events = await tx.ticketEvent.findMany({ ...paging, where, select: { id: true, type: true, content: true } });
      return pageOf(events.map(e => ({ id: e.id, type: e.type, content: shortText(e.content) })), limit);
    }
    default: throw new CallError('TOOL_NOT_READABLE');
  }
}

import { BadRequestException, Injectable, NotFoundException } from '@nestjs/common';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { AuditService } from '../audit/audit.service.js';
import { readAccess } from '../assistant/read-tools.service.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { PrismaService } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { RunFailure } from './run-errors.js';
import { AgentRunsService } from './agent-runs.service.js';
import { CallError, catalog, parseCall } from './tool-catalog.js';
import { saveNote, listNotes } from './ticket-tool-note.js';
import { readTicketTool, visibleTicket } from './ticket-tool-read.js';
import { decideTool, type ToolScene } from './agent-permission.js';
import { ToolPolicy } from './tool-policy.js';

export const batchSchema = z.object({ calls: z.array(z.unknown()).min(1).max(3) }).strict();
function describe(input: unknown) {
  const value = z.object({ name: z.string().regex(/^[a-z_]{1,50}$/), version: z.number().int() }).safeParse(input);
  return value.success ? value.data : { name: 'invalid', version: 0 };
}
function errorCode(error: unknown) {
  if (error instanceof CallError) return error.code;
  if (error instanceof Error && error.message === 'TOOL_FORBIDDEN') return 'TOOL_FORBIDDEN';
  return 'TOOL_FAILED';
}
@Injectable()
export class TicketToolsService {
  private readonly policy = new ToolPolicy();
  constructor(private readonly db: PrismaService, private readonly runs: AgentRunsService, private readonly audit: AuditService) {}

  async owned(user: AuthUser, id: string) {
    try { return await this.runs.get(user, id); }
    catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof RunFailure && error.code.endsWith('NOT_FOUND')) throw new NotFoundException('运行不可见');
      if (error instanceof RunFailure && error.code === 'RUN_INPUT_INVALID') throw new BadRequestException('运行编号无效');
      throw error;
    }
  }
  async history(user: AuthUser, id: string, after?: string) {
    await this.owned(user, id);
    const page = await this.db.auditLog.findMany({
      where: { entityType: 'user', entityKey: user.id, actorId: user.id, action: 'agent.tool_call',
        before: { path: ['runId'], equals: id }, ...(after ? { id: { lt: after } } : {}) },
      select: { id: true, actorUsername: true, occurredAt: true, requestId: true, before: true, after: true },
      take: 21, orderBy: { id: 'desc' },
    });
    const items = page.slice(0, 20);
    return { items, next: page.length > 20 ? items.at(-1)!.id : null };
  }
  async batch(user: AuthUser, runId: string, inputs: unknown[], signal: AbortSignal, allowWrites = false) {
    const run = await this.owned(user, runId);
    batchSchema.parse({ calls: inputs });
    // 每个槽独立结束。写工具只接受单项调用，避免用并行顺序表达依赖。
    return Promise.all(inputs.map(input => this.invoke(user, run.id, run.ticketNo, input, signal, allowWrites ? 'workbench' : 'diagnosis', allowWrites && inputs.length === 1)));
  }
  private async invoke(user: AuthUser, runId: string, ticketNo: string, input: unknown, signal: AbortSignal, scene: ToolScene, allowWrites: boolean) {
    const description = describe(input);
    const argsHash = createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(input ?? null)).digest('hex');
    let parameters: Prisma.InputJsonObject = {};
    const base = { actorId: user.id, actorUsername: user.username, action: 'agent.tool_call',
      entityType: 'user' as const, entityKey: user.id };
    try {
      const call = parseCall(input);
      if (call.effect === 'write' && !allowWrites) throw new CallError('TOOL_WRITE_REQUIRES_SINGLE');
      // 审计展示可检索的非正文参数。笔记正文仅记录摘要和长度。
      const args = call.args as { limit?: number; after?: string | null; requestKey?: string; text?: string };
      parameters = args.requestKey ? { requestKey: args.requestKey, chars: args.text?.length ?? 0 } :
        args.limit ? { limit: args.limit, after: args.after ?? null } : {};
      const result = await this.policy.run(call.name, call.effect === 'read' || call.name === 'save_private_note', signal, async child => {
        try {
          return await this.db.$transaction(async tx => {
            child.throwIfAborted();
            await tx.$executeRaw`SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '1200ms'`;
            const access = await readAccess(tx, user.id);
            if (decideTool(access.user.permissions ?? [], scene, call.name) !== 'allow') throw new CallError('TOOL_FORBIDDEN');
            let value: unknown;
            if (call.name === 'save_private_note' || call.name === 'list_private_notes') {
              const target = await visibleTicket(tx, access.user, ticketNo);
              value = call.name === 'save_private_note' ? await saveNote(tx, user.id, target.id, call.args) :
                await listNotes(tx, user.id, target.id, call.args);
            } else value = await readTicketTool(tx, access.user, ticketNo, call.name, call.args);
            await this.audit.record(tx, { ...base, before: { runId, ...description, argsHash, parameters },
              after: { ok: true, effect: catalog[call.name].effect, resultBytes: Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(value)) } });
            child.throwIfAborted();
            return value;
          }, { maxWait: 500, timeout: 1600, isolationLevel: 'RepeatableRead' });
        } catch (error) {
          if (error instanceof Prisma.PrismaClientKnownRequestError) {
            if (['P2024', 'P2034'].includes(error.code)) throw new CallError('TOOL_TEMPORARY');
            if (error.code === 'P2028') throw new CallError('TOOL_TIMEOUT');
          }
          throw error;
        }
      });
      return { ...description, ok: true as const, data: result.value, attempts: result.attempts };
    } catch (error) {
      const code = errorCode(error);
      try {
        await this.db.$transaction(tx => this.audit.record(tx, { ...base, before: { runId, ...description, argsHash, parameters },
          after: { ok: false, code } }), { maxWait: 500, timeout: 1000 });
      } catch { return { ...description, ok: false as const, code: 'TOOL_AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE' }; }
      return { ...description, ok: false as const, code };
    }
  }
}

import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { z } from 'zod';
import type { Permission } from '@ops-ticket/shared';
import { PrismaService, type TransactionClient } from '../prisma/prisma.service.js';
import { Prisma } from '../generated/prisma/client.js';
import { groupScope } from '../auth/group-scope.js';
import type { AuthUser } from '../auth/auth.types.js';
import { ToolFailure, toolNameSchema, type ToolCall, type ToolMessage } from './tool-protocol.js';

const ticketNo = z.string().trim().regex(/^[A-Z0-9-]{1,20}$/);
const limit = z.number().int().min(1).max(5);
const schemas = {
  find_ticket: z.object({ ticketNo }).strict(),
  list_device_alerts: z.object({ deviceCode: z.string().trim().regex(/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,32}$/), limit }).strict(),
  list_ticket_history: z.object({ ticketNo, limit }).strict(),
};
const descriptions = {
  find_ticket: '按完整工单编号查询当前用户可见工单，只读；编号须来自用户或已有结果，不猜测。',
  list_device_alerts: '按完整设备编号查询当前用户可见设备最近告警，只读，limit为1到5。',
  list_ticket_history: '按完整工单编号查询当前用户可见工单最近处理记录，只读，limit为1到5。',
};
export const readToolDefinitions = Object.entries(schemas).map(([name, schema]) => ({
  type: 'function' as const,
  function: { name, description: descriptions[name as keyof typeof schemas], strict: true, parameters: z.toJSONSchema(schema) },
}));

export interface ToolAccess { user: AuthUser; fingerprint: string; }
export async function readAccess(db: Pick<TransactionClient, 'user'>, userId: string): Promise<ToolAccess> {
  const user = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId }, select: { id: true, username: true, groupId: true, tenantKey: true,
    roles: { select: { role: { select: { permissions: { select: { permission: { select: { code: true } } } } } } } },
  } });
  const permissions = [...new Set(user?.roles.flatMap(r => r.role.permissions.map(p => p.permission.code as Permission)) ?? [])].sort();
  if (!user || !permissions.includes('ticket:read')) throw new ToolFailure('TOOL_FORBIDDEN');
  return { user: { id: user.id, username: user.username, groupId: user.groupId, tenantKey: user.tenantKey, permissions },
    fingerprint: createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(user.tenantKey === 'legacy' ? [user.groupId, permissions] : [user.tenantKey, user.groupId, permissions])).digest('hex') };
}

@Injectable()
export class ReadToolsService {
  constructor(private readonly db: PrismaService) {}
  // 工具不沿用30秒缓存，每次执行重新读取数据库中的权限和班组。
  access(userId: string) { return readAccess(this.db, userId); }
  // 历史回显和再次发给模型前，批量复核直接查询过的资源；不重跑工具或刷新历史结果。
  async assertReferences(userId: string, messages: ToolMessage[], expectedFingerprint: string) {
    const tickets = new Set<string>(), devices = new Set<string>();
    for (const message of messages) {
      if (message.role !== 'assistant') continue;
      for (const call of message.tool_calls ?? []) {
        let raw: unknown;
        try { raw = JSON.parse(call.function.arguments); } catch { throw new ToolFailure('CONVERSATION_HISTORY_INVALID'); }
        const parsed = schemas[call.function.name].safeParse(raw);
        if (!parsed.success) throw new ToolFailure('CONVERSATION_HISTORY_INVALID');
        if ('ticketNo' in parsed.data) tickets.add(parsed.data.ticketNo);
        if ('deviceCode' in parsed.data) devices.add(parsed.data.deviceCode);
      }
    }
    if (tickets.size + devices.size > 120) throw new ToolFailure('CONVERSATION_HISTORY_INVALID');
    await this.db.$transaction(async tx => {
      await tx.$executeRaw`SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '1500ms'`;
      const access = await readAccess(tx, userId);
      if (access.fingerprint !== expectedFingerprint) throw new ToolFailure('CONVERSATION_SCOPE_CHANGED');
      const scope = groupScope(access.user);
      const visibleTickets = await tx.ticket.count({ where: { ticketNo: { in: [...tickets] }, ...scope } });
      const visibleDevices = await tx.device.count({ where: { code: { in: [...devices] }, ...scope } });
      if (visibleTickets !== tickets.size || visibleDevices !== devices.size) throw new ToolFailure('CONVERSATION_RESOURCE_CHANGED');
    }, { isolationLevel: Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel.RepeatableRead, timeout: 2000, maxWait: 1000 });
  }

  async execute(call: ToolCall, userId: string, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<unknown> {
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    const name = toolNameSchema.safeParse(call.function.name);
    if (!name.success) throw new ToolFailure('TOOL_NOT_ALLOWED');
    let raw: unknown;
    try { raw = JSON.parse(call.function.arguments); } catch { throw new ToolFailure('TOOL_ARGUMENTS_INVALID'); }
    const parsed = schemas[name.data].safeParse(raw);
    if (!parsed.success) throw new ToolFailure('TOOL_ARGUMENTS_INVALID');
    const input = parsed.data;
    const result = await this.db.$transaction(async tx => {
      await tx.$executeRaw`SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '1500ms'`;
      const { user } = await readAccess(tx, userId);
      const scope = groupScope(user);
      signal.throwIfAborted();
      if (name.data === 'list_device_alerts' && 'deviceCode' in input) {
        const device = await tx.device.findFirst({ where: { code: input.deviceCode, ...scope }, select: { id: true, code: true } });
        if (!device) throw new ToolFailure('TOOL_NOT_FOUND');
        const rows = await tx.alert.findMany({ where: { deviceId: device.id }, orderBy: [{ occurredAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }], take: input.limit + 1,
          select: { severity: true, message: true, occurredAt: true } });
        return { deviceCode: device.code, more: rows.length > input.limit, rows: rows.slice(0, input.limit).map(r => ({ severity: r.severity, message: r.message.slice(0, 120), clipped: r.message.length > 120, occurredAt: r.occurredAt.toISOString() })) };
      }
      if (!('ticketNo' in input)) throw new ToolFailure('TOOL_ARGUMENTS_INVALID');
      const ticket = await tx.ticket.findFirst({ where: { ticketNo: input.ticketNo, ...scope },
        select: { id: true, ticketNo: true, title: true, description: true, status: true, priority: true, device: { select: { code: true } } } });
      if (!ticket) throw new ToolFailure('TOOL_NOT_FOUND');
      if (name.data === 'find_ticket') return { ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo, title: ticket.title.slice(0, 160), description: ticket.description.slice(0, 500), clipped: ticket.title.length > 160 || ticket.description.length > 500, status: ticket.status, priority: ticket.priority, deviceCode: ticket.device?.code ?? null };
      if (!('limit' in input) || typeof input.limit !== 'number') throw new ToolFailure('TOOL_ARGUMENTS_INVALID');
      const rows = await tx.ticketEvent.findMany({ where: { ticketId: ticket.id }, orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }], take: input.limit + 1,
        select: { type: true, content: true, createdAt: true } });
      return { ticketNo: ticket.ticketNo, more: rows.length > input.limit, rows: rows.slice(0, input.limit).map(r => ({ type: r.type, content: r.content.slice(0, 120), clipped: r.content.length > 120, createdAt: r.createdAt.toISOString() })) };
    }, { isolationLevel: Prisma.TransactionIsolationLevel.RepeatableRead, timeout: 2000, maxWait: 1000 });
    signal.throwIfAborted();
    if (Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(result), 'utf8') > 4096) throw new ToolFailure('TOOL_RESULT_LIMIT');
    return result;
  }
}
